Smart Stewardship and Responsive Fundraising are not opposing concepts; rather, they are modern, complementary approaches designed to move nonprofits away from transactional fundraising toward long-term, relationship-based sustainability.
Smart Stewardship: The 'How' of Retention.
note: Virtuous owns Responsive Fundraising. DonorDock should claim Smart Stewardship more aggressively.
